title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
lede: Anthropic's Claude Ship bundles agents that review pull requests, repair them and, under a policy the team writes, approve routine changes without waiting on a human.

points: Code Review is already generally available; PR Steward and Claude Approvals launch in beta.
PR Steward handles failing CI, merge conflicts and review feedback, and comments after each push on what it changed and how to roll it back.
Claude Approvals applies a natural-language policy stored as a file in the repo, and can weigh Code Review findings or a team's own classifiers.
Anthropic suggests running approvals in observe-only mode first, on one repository, with a monthly spend limit.
It is rolling out to Claude Team and Enterprise plans for GitHub repositories.

sections.text: As agents produce more code, review and approval become the bottleneck. Claude Ship moves merge authority into a policy file a team can read, version and tighten, with escalation to a person for changes it names.
